name: Hand-over
description: Give items to the player next to you: /handover wood 20 in the game's chat hands 20 wood logs to the nearest other player within 5 m (/handover.to Alice wood 20 picks one). It runs where the world runs (the host or a dedicated server), so players who joined need nothing. Items are never lost: what does not fit comes back, and what cannot come back drops at your feet. Gear is refused (it would lose its gems and perks). The host also gets a wheel on a key.

settings.label: Reach (m)
settings.help: Items go to a player at most this far from you.

settings.label: Wait between hand-overs (s)
settings.help: Per player: keeps the chat calm.

settings.label: Allow gear
settings.help: Gear loses its gems and perks when handed over (the game makes a new copy with the same level and rarity). Off: gear is refused; use a chest.

settings.label: Tell both players
settings.help: A chat line for the giver and the receiver when the items arrived (the host gets a note on screen).

settings.label: Your wheel (host)
settings.help: Hold it: pick a player near you, then a stack, then how many. Empty = no wheel.
